name: hunt-strike
notes: Baseline (#352): today's hunt, a miss, staged as LifePlanner.Hunt plans it and PeopleView/RabbitView play it. Fire at (-1.0, -0.25), rabbit at (0.5, 0.15): stalk point 0.5 short of it (StalkRange), lunge point 3/4 of the way in (0.125 off the rabbit). Beats at the morning's 16 s per view hour: the end of the walk out (WalkSpeed 5 u/h = 0.31 u/s), Stalk 0.3 h (creeps stalk -> lunge), Strike 0.06 h (DollMotion.Hunt: wind-up and thrust, hit at progress 0.6-0.8, the spear stays in the hand), Bolt 0.12 h (arms out), then the walk back. The stalked rabbit minds nobody until the strike is over (RabbitView: hunted until the resolve hour), only sits up with the hunter inside 0.8; then RabbitHerd.Scare runs as in the game. Two more rabbits graze nearby and get the plain Scare.
